name: Magpie Subscription Usage
description: Shows subscription allowance windows from Magpie accounts in Persona.

local_address.title: Local Magpie address
local_address.description: On the Persona manager's machine. The default needs no setup.

remote_address.title: Remote Magpie HTTPS address (optional)
remote_address.description: Leave empty to read local Magpie. Save this address before setting a dedicated read-only Magpie quota key.

include_providers.title: Only sync these providers (optional)
include_providers.description: Leave empty to sync all Magpie subscription providers that report periodic allowance windows. Example: claude, antigravity.

exclude_providers.title: Exclude providers (optional)
exclude_providers.description: Skip these Magpie providers, such as codex when Persona already reads local Codex usage.

anonymous_names.title: Hide account names (anonymous mode)
anonymous_names.description: Show opaque per-account aliases instead of Magpie account aliases or usernames in Persona.

secrets.name: magpie_quota_key
secrets.title: Remote Magpie quota key
secrets.description: A dedicated Magpie read-only key with quota access. Never sent to the local endpoint.
